annotations.title: Start an order for a customer

description: Creates a short-lived cart for a customer at one Shortlist business and returns a cart_url on the business's own page, where the customer reviews the order and pays through the business's checkout. Input is offering ids and quantities; prices are not accepted. The server prices every line from the menu, applies the business's deals and tax, and returns the resulting quote. For businesses with menu_source "event" (food trucks), event_id is required and identifies one upcoming stop; the offering ids accepted are those listed in that stop's menu in the upcoming-events data, and pickup_time is one of that stop's open pickup_slots. A stop whose menu_status is "not_live" is refused. The cart expires in 30 minutes. This tool does not accept payment details or addresses; payment happens on the business's page at the returned cart_url. In the quote, total_before_tip excludes the optional tip, which the customer chooses on the checkout page; quote.tip.note states the business's suggested percentage. agent.name is recorded on the cart and the order so the business can see which assistant helped.

agent.description: The name of the assistant placing the order, e.g. { "name": "Claude" }. Optional; defaults to "AI assistant".

customer.description: Customer details, if provided; pre-filled on the order sheet

event_id.description: A stop id from the upcoming-events results. Required for businesses with menu_source "event".

offering_id.description: An offering id from the stop's menu (or from the menu results for a fixed business)

options.description: The offering's own variant or modifier choices, by option value or label

pickup_time.description: One of the stop's open pickup_slots, "HH:MM" 24-hour

name: start_order
